name: minimax-h3-image
description: MiniMax H3 Image is MiniMax's image generation and editing model. It creates images from text prompts and edits or composes images from 1 to 16 reference images, with output up to 20 megapixels and aspect ratios from 1:3 to 3:1.
zhDescription: MiniMax H3 Image 是 MiniMax 推出的图像生成与编辑模型，支持根据文本提示生成图像，也可基于 1 至 16 张参考图进行编辑或合成。输出图像最高可达 2000 万像素，支持 1:3 至 3:1 的宽高比。
longDescription: MiniMax H3 Image is MiniMax's image generation and editing model. It creates images from text prompts and edits or composes images from 1 to 16 reference images, with output up to 20 megapixels and aspect ratios from 1:3 to 3:1.
zhLongDescription: MiniMax H3 Image 是 MiniMax 推出的图像生成与编辑模型，支持根据文本提示生成图像，也可基于 1 至 16 张参考图进行编辑或合成。输出图像最高可达 2000 万像素，支持 1:3 至 3:1 的宽高比。

  --max-time 660 \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  --data '{"model":"minimax-h3-image","prompt":"一只坐在窗边的橘猫。","n":1,"size":"1024x1024","response_format":"url","stream":false}'","sectionTitle":"文生图","name":"curl"},{"code":"import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v1",
    max_retries=0,
    timeout=660.0,
)
response = client.images.generate(
    model="minimax-h3-image",
    prompt="一只坐在窗边的橘猫。",
    n=1,
    size="1024x1024",
    response_format="url",
)
for item in response.data:
    if item.url:
        print(item.url)","sectionTitle":"文生图","name":"python"}]}}
